# imd/acc - Agent Spec

imd/acc pays trading cashback as staked IMD (sIMD).
A project calls Stacker.credit(trader, amount); the IMD goes into the sIMD vault in the trader's name and a Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares) event records it.
The ProjectRegistry lists the projects whose credits earn points, decided by an IdentityMD oracle panel.

Site: https://imdacc.fun
Data API (JSON, every chain's cashback and points, about every 15 minutes): https://imdacc.fun/data/v1/index.json (format: https://github.com/khaed1/imd-acc/blob/main/docs/data-api.md)

## Ethereum mainnet (1)

- Stacker: 0x06909f672301f28a810f78cfe7a754851269f4f0 (launch #1409; credit refuses the Stacker, the vault and the IMD token as trader)
- ProjectRegistry: 0x7f53fa1543c682bb5de3f50c2cf3d1842ae57faa (launch #1495, panel rules version 3.1; a project that reports an owner() is applied for by that owner; fee 0.5 IMD, challenge bond 20 IMD, cooldown 7 days)
- StackReceiver: 0x1999a54f573dac75ce8ef62a555dba418c9b3d10 (launch #1529; the Ethereum end of the multichain route: deposits cashback bridged from other chains into sIMD per trader)
- IMD: 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7
- sIMD: 0x9efa934d9fad4ae28c998a40195646b965a97247

## Robinhood Chain (4663)

- RemoteStacker: 0x4de07c2fa46d5d6ed9ceb3f38ec56d3461b3e898 (launch #1537; the same credit(trader, imdAmount); cashback waits per trader and anyone flushes up to 50 traders to the StackReceiver on Ethereum through IMD's LayerZero bridge for a tip of up to 2%; Queued(project, trader, recipient, imd) is the points record)
- IMD: 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 (the same OFT over IMD's bridge, 6 shared decimals)
- Intake v2: 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82
- ProjectRegistry: not launched yet; credits on Robinhood Chain earn no points until it is

## Integration Pattern

```solidity
interface IStacker {
    function credit(address trader, uint256 imdAmount) external returns (uint256 shares);
}

// In your pool hook's afterSwap, with the real trader resolved (rule 2):
uint256 cashback = imdSideAmount * RATE_BPS / 10_000; // 25-100 bps
require(gasleft() >= 410_000, "imd/acc: insufficient gas"); // 350k covers the first-ever credit
try stacker.credit{gas: 350_000}(trader, cashback) returns (uint256 shares) {
    // trader holds sIMD shares
} catch {
    // Fallback: pay plain IMD so trades never revert
    IERC20(imd).transfer(trader, cashback);
}
```

MUST rules:
1. Call credit from the trading contract itself, which holds the IMD and approved the Stacker.
2. Only inside a trade, for that trade's real trader: valid router hookData, else the router's msgSender(), else sender only if it has no code. Never tx.origin, never pay a router (in a Uniswap v4 hook sender is usually the router).
3. Rate must be between 25 and 100 bps (0.25% - 1%).
4. Always wrap in try/catch and pay plain IMD if it fails.
